description.value: While you hold your censer, it billows smoke that obscures creatures within the area. You can light or extinguish your censer with a thought once each turn as a free action, which has the concentrate trait. The smoke fills a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], and all creatures take a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks and ranged attack rolls against creatures within the smoke. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Swing the Censer] action.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
